name: Hand Over Your Items
summary: Give items directly to another player without dropping them. Sneak and right-click a player to hand them your whole held stack; overflow drops at their feet if their inventory is full.

mechanics.title: Messages
mechanics.description: Both players get a chat message by default (sendItemGivenMessage, sendItemReceivedMessage); sneaking is required by default (mustCrouchToGiveItem).

commands_and_keybinds: Sneak + right-click another player with an item: give the entire main-hand stack
editor_notes: Author recommends installing on both client and server; server-only can desync.
